detail.body:
- Route causal verify longer than 4 tokens on CDNA3 (no DCP) to a new Triton verify kernel in `rocm_aiter_mla.py`; shorter verify, decode, prefill, DCP and gfx950 keep their current paths.
- Add `decode_attention_fwd_verify` to `triton_decode_attention.py`: one program reads each KV tile once for a block of a request's (token, head) rows, with a per-row causal limit, int64 page offsets and FP8 dequant. Its variants are compiled before serving, so ngram drafts of any length never JIT mid-request.
- Undo the FP8 V-scale drop of AITER's qlen 2-4 FP8 decode kernel (ROCm/aiter#6732), found by a one-time probe, so a fixed AITER turns the correction off by itself.
- Apply the per-TP head override of `test_mla_backends.py` on ROCm as well (it was XPU only), so ROCm CI tests real per-rank head counts instead of 128 heads at every TP.
- Below page size 8 with bf16, read the block table one tile ahead instead of two: above 2 GiB of KV, Triton's global-load variant of the kernel otherwise spills VGPRs (2.1-3.1x slower at `--block-size 1`).
- Add an op test for the new kernel (bf16 and FP8, pages 1 and 16, ragged, padded and varlen rows).

On MI300X, MTP or ngram with 4 or more draft tokens fails at startup: AITER's persistent bf16 MLA decode only has kernels up to 4 query tokens, and its non-persistent kernels are not a safe fallback. They return wrong results at 32 heads, ignore the causal mask at 64/128 heads, and at 16 heads (what padded ranks such as TP2 of a 16-head model use today) read the wrong KV pages once the cache passes 4 GiB (ROCm/aiter#6733). That last case is silent: DeepSeek-V2-Lite at TP2 with k=7 drops to GSM8K 0.004 once serving fills the cache past 4 GiB, and goes back to 0.605 with this PR. Raising an error instead (as #57642 does) would leave MTP 4+ unusable on MI300 and break the gfx942 DCP verify routes that work today. This fixes item 1 of #55609 and needs no AITER change to be correct.

**Still open on the AITER side (not blocking this PR, but blocking a fully green `test_mla_backends.py` on MI300):**
- ROCm/aiter#6731: the persistent `_ps` decode kernel returns wrong output in about 1 of 1000 calls (a race). ROCm/aiter#6277 (open) brings it to 6 bad calls in 250k but not to zero. In 30 runs of the whole file on this branch it shows up as an occasional `ROCM_AITER_MLA` mismatch on unchanged decode paths.
- ROCm/aiter#6735, fixed by ROCm/aiter#6748 (rounds CK forward attention to nearest): `test_chunked_context_backend_correctness[...glm...]` fails on main and on this branch because CK's FMHA forward truncates bf16; it passes 100/100 seeds with that change.
- ROCm/aiter#6732, ROCm/aiter#6733: the FP8 V-scale and the non-persistent kernel bugs worked around here.

**Results** (MI300X, AITER v0.1.25, DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Chat, `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1`, ngram drafts; `vllm bench serve`, mean of 2 runs, output tok/s):

| config | workload | main | this PR |
|---|---|---|---|
| TP1, no spec | InstructCoder c1 / c32 | 281 / 2046 | 280 / 2001 |
| TP1, no spec | random 1k/256 c1 / c32 | 259 / 3202 | 258 / 3100 |
| TP1, k=3 | InstructCoder c1 / c32 | 306 / 2507 | 315 / 2669 |
| TP1, k=7 | InstructCoder c1 / c32 | startup fails | 339 / 2700 |
| TP1, k=7 | random 1k/256 c1 / c32 | startup fails | 325 / 3201 |
| TP2, k=7 | InstructCoder c1 / c32 | 356 / 3042 | 370 / 3264 |
| TP2, k=7 | random 1k/256 c1 / c32 | 324 / 3557 | 369 / 3766 |

The c32 differences without spec decode are within this host's run-to-run noise (the same path runs on both). GSM8K 5-shot (lm_eval, 1319) is 0.647-0.663 for every config on both branches, and the TP2 k=7 0.004 above is the >4 GiB case.

**Against the per-token row-view** (what gfx942 DCP verify uses: one row per draft token through the generic split-KV kernel). MI300X, AITER v0.1.27, DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Chat, ngram k=7, TP1, one server at a time on the same GPU, output tok/s:

| | InstructCoder c1 / c32 | random 1k/256 c1 / c32 |
|---|---|---|
| this PR | 426 / 3864 | 490 / 4606 |
| row-view, launch config and splits tuned for gfx942 | 400 / 3520 | 454 / 4086 |
| row-view, as it ships | 290 / 3385 | 313 / 3511 |

Per layer, with both kernels in HIP graphs on identical inputs and a production-size KV pool, row-view is 1.8-4.6x slower as it ships and 1.44x slower on geomean when tuned (0.96-2.4x across 16-128 heads and batch 1-64). The c1 gap over tuned row-view (6-8%) is outside this host's noise; at c32 this PR is ahead in every round run, but by less than the c32 run-to-run spread. TP2 and k=5 show the same ordering, and GSM8K is 0.648-0.668 on every arm.

Tests: `pytest tests/kernels/attention/test_triton_decode_attention.py -k verify` (48 passed; 10/10 runs with the page-size fix), `tests/v1/attention/test_rocm_aiter_mla_mtp_split.py`, and `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1 pytest tests/v1/attention/test_mla_backends.py` 30 times: every run passes all spec-decode and verify cases (634 passed). The two remaining failures are both AITER-side and listed above: `test_chunked_context_backend_correctness[...auto-glm...]` fails in all 30 runs (max diff 0.031, identical on `TRITON_MLA`, the CK prefill), and 8 of 30 runs have one FP8 `large_decode` (qlen 1, unchanged decode path) `ROCM_AITER_MLA` mismatch of 0.16-0.39 from the persistent-kernel race. On main the 16 `spec_decode_medium` cases fail every run with `cannot get heuristic kernel ... qseqlen:8`.

AI assistance (Claude Code) was used to draft this change. Every line was reviewed by the submitter.

     assert torch.equal(lse[-1:], lse_last)

+def _verify_reference(q, cache, block_table, seq_lens, real_seq_lens, qlen, scale):
+    """Causal MLA verify in the dtype of ``cache``: row t of a request attends
+    its first min(L - qlen + 1 + t, L_real) tokens; a row with none comes back
+    zero. A bf16 ``cache`` also rounds P to bf16 before the PV product, as the
+    kernel does."""
+    kv_lora_rank = 512
+    page_size = cache.shape[1]
+    lowp = cache.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+    dtype = torch.float32 if lowp else cache.dtype
+    out = torch.zeros(
+        q.shape[0], q.shape[1], kv_lora_rank, dtype=dtype, device=q.device
+    )
+    for b, seq_len in enumerate(seq_lens.tolist()):
+        real = seq_len if real_seq_lens is None else real_seq_lens[b].item()
+        lim = (torch.arange(qlen) + seq_len - qlen + 1).clamp(0, real).tolist()
+        if max(lim) == 0:
+            continue
+        num_pages = cdiv(seq_len, page_size)
+        kv = cache[block_table[b, :num_pages].long()].reshape(-1, cache.shape[-1])
+        kv = kv[: max(lim)].to(dtype)
+        rows = slice(b * qlen, (b + 1) * qlen)
+        s = torch.einsum("thd,kd->thk", q[rows].to(dtype), kv) * scale
+        keys = torch.arange(kv.shape[0], device=q.device)
+        hidden = keys[None, :] >= torch.tensor(lim, device=q.device)[:, None]
+        s = s.masked_fill(hidden[:, None, :], float("-inf"))
+        p = torch.exp(s - s.amax(-1, keepdim=True)).nan_to_num(0.0)
+        pv = p.bfloat16().to(dtype) if lowp else p
+        o = torch.einsum("thk,kd->thd", pv, kv[:, :kv_lora_rank])
+        out[rows] = o / p.sum(-1, keepdim=True).clamp(min=1e-30)
+    return out.bfloat16().to(dtype) if lowp else out
+
+
+@pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not current_platform.is_rocm(), reason="Only the ROCm AITER MLA backend uses it"
+)
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("num_heads", [8, 16, 128])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("qlen", [5, 8])
+# 3 requests stay on the small-tile config; 24 reach the 64-row tiles.
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("batch", [3, 24])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("page_size", [1, 16])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("kv_dtype", ["bf16", "fp8"])
+# 1 skips stage 2; 32 combines more splits than one stage-2 step holds.
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("num_kv_splits", [1, 4, 32])
+def test_decode_attention_fwd_verify(
+    num_heads, qlen, batch, page_size, kv_dtype, num_kv_splits
+):
+    from vllm.v1.attention.ops.triton_decode_attention import (
+        decode_attention_fwd_verify,
+    )
+
+    set_random_seed(0)
+    dim, kv_lora_rank = 576, 512
+    scale = 1.0 / (192**0.5)
+    # Ragged lengths, one shorter than qlen, one long enough for 32 splits,
+    # and a graph padding request.
+    lens = torch.randint(qlen, 700, (batch,))
+    lens[0] = qlen - 2
+    lens[1] = 4500
+    lens[-1] = 0
+    seq_lens = lens.to(torch.int32).to(DEVICE_TYPE)
+    pages_per_req = cdiv(int(lens.max()), page_size) + 1
+    num_pages = batch * pages_per_req + 3
+    block_table = (
+        torch.randperm(num_pages - 1, device=DEVICE_TYPE)[: batch * pages_per_req]
+        .view(batch, pages_per_req)
+        .to(torch.int32)
+    )
+    cache = torch.randn(num_pages, page_size, dim, device=DEVICE_TYPE) * 0.5
+    # Keys past each request's length, and the pages its table does not use,
+    # are NaN, so reading any of them fails instead of passing on valid data.
+    poison = num_pages - 1
+    cache[poison] = float("nan")
+    for b, n in enumerate(lens.tolist()):
+        used = cdiv(n, page_size)
+        block_table[b, used:] = poison
+        if n % page_size:
+            cache[block_table[b, used - 1], n % page_size :] = float("nan")
+    k_scale = torch.tensor(1.0, device=DEVICE_TYPE)
+    if kv_dtype == "fp8":
+        cache = cache.to(current_platform.fp8_dtype())
+        # Not a power of two, so dequantized keys round when cast to bf16.
+        k_scale = torch.tensor(0.37, device=DEVICE_TYPE)
+    else:
+        cache = cache.to(torch.bfloat16)
+    exact_cache = cache.double() * k_scale.item()
+    q = torch.randn(batch * qlen, num_heads, dim, device=DEVICE_TYPE).to(torch.bfloat16)
+    paged = cache.unsqueeze(2)
+    for real_seq_lens in (None, (seq_lens - 2).clamp(min=0)):
+        o = torch.full(
+            (batch * qlen, num_heads, kv_lora_rank),
+            float("nan"),
+            dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+            device=DEVICE_TYPE,
+        )
+        lse = torch.empty(batch * qlen, num_heads, device=DEVICE_TYPE)
+        logits = torch.full(
+            (batch * qlen, num_heads, num_kv_splits, kv_lora_rank + 1),
+            float("nan"),
+            device=DEVICE_TYPE,
+        )
+        decode_attention_fwd_verify(
+            q,
+            paged,
+            paged[..., :kv_lora_rank],
+            o,
+            lse,
+            block_table,
+            seq_lens,
+            real_seq_lens,
+            qlen,
+            logits,
+            num_kv_splits,
+            scale,
+            page_size,
+            k_scale=k_scale,
+        )
+        args = (block_table, seq_lens, real_seq_lens, qlen, scale)
+        ref = _verify_reference(q, exact_cache, *args)
+        # The kernel rounds the dequantized keys, P and the output to bf16;
+        # a reference with the same roundings bounds its error from fp64.
+        # Per request, so short requests do not set the long ones' bound.
+        ref_bf16 = _verify_reference(q, exact_cache.bfloat16(), *args).double()
+        err = (o.double() - ref).abs().view(batch, -1).amax(-1)
+        bf16_err = (ref_bf16 - ref).abs().view(batch, -1).amax(-1)
+        assert (err <= 2 * bf16_err).all(), (err, bf16_err)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not current_platform.is_rocm(), reason="Only the ROCm AITER MLA backend uses it"
+)
+def test_decode_attention_fwd_verify_int64_page_offset():
+    """Page offsets must not overflow int32 once the cache holds more than
+    2**31 elements (fp8 past 2 GiB)."""
+    from vllm.v1.attention.ops.triton_decode_attention import (
+        decode_attention_fwd_verify,
+    )
+
+    dim, kv_lora_rank, page_size, qlen, num_heads = 576, 512, 16, 8, 16
+    pages_per_req = cdiv(200, page_size)
+    # Every page the table points at starts past element 2**31.
+    first_high = 2**31 // (page_size * dim) + 1
+    num_pages = first_high + 2 * pages_per_req
+    if torch.accelerator.get_memory_info()[0] < num_pages * page_size * dim + 2**30:
+        pytest.skip("needs about 3 GiB of free device memory")
+    set_random_seed(0)
+    fp8 = current_platform.fp8_dtype()
+    big = torch.empty(num_pages, page_size, 1, dim, dtype=fp8, device=DEVICE_TYPE)
+    seq_lens = torch.tensor([200, 37], dtype=torch.int32, device=DEVICE_TYPE)
+    high = torch.arange(first_high, num_pages, device=DEVICE_TYPE)
+    block_table = high.view(2, pages_per_req).to(torch.int32)
+    data = torch.randn(2 * pages_per_req, page_size, 1, dim, device=DEVICE_TYPE)
+    big[high] = data.to(fp8)
+    small = big[high].clone()
+    small_table = torch.arange(2 * pages_per_req, device=DEVICE_TYPE)
+    small_table = small_table.view(2, pages_per_req).to(torch.int32)
+    q = torch.randn(2 * qlen, num_heads, dim, device=DEVICE_TYPE).to(torch.bfloat16)
+    k_scale = torch.tensor(0.37, device=DEVICE_TYPE)
+
+    def run(cache, table):
+        rows = 2 * qlen
+        o = torch.empty(
+            rows, num_heads, kv_lora_rank, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=DEVICE_TYPE
+        )
+        lse = torch.empty(rows, num_heads, device=DEVICE_TYPE)
+        logits = torch.empty(rows, num_heads, 2, kv_lora_rank + 1, device=DEVICE_TYPE)
+        decode_attention_fwd_verify(
+            q,
+            cache,
+            cache[..., :kv_lora_rank],
+            o,
+            lse,
+            table,
+            seq_lens,
+            None,
+            qlen,
+            logits,
+            2,
+            dim**-0.5,
+            page_size,
+            k_scale=k_scale,
+        )
+        return o, lse
+
+    o_big, lse_big = run(big, block_table)
+    o_small, lse_small = run(small, small_table)
+    # Same data and compute order; only the page offsets differ.
+    assert torch.equal(o_big, o_small)
+    assert torch.equal(lse_big, lse_small)

+        offs_d0 = tl.arange(0, HALF)
+        if QSPLIT:
+            # Two half-width Q tiles: halves the LDS scratch of the Q layout
+            # conversion at large BLOCK_H.
+            q = tl.load(
+                Q + offs_q + offs_d0[None, :], mask=row_valid[:, None], other=0.0
+            )
+            q1 = tl.load(
+                Q + offs_q + HALF + offs_d0[None, :],
+                mask=row_valid[:, None],
+                other=0.0,
+            )
+        else:
+            q = tl.load(
+                Q + offs_q + offs_d[None, :],
+                mask=row_valid[:, None],
+                other=0.0,
+            )
+        if BLOCK_DPE > 0:
+            offs_dpe = BLOCK_DMODEL + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_DPE)
+            qpe = tl.load(
+                Q + offs_q + offs_dpe[None, :],
+                mask=row_valid[:, None],
+                other=0.0,
+            )
+        else:
+            offs_dpe = offs_d0
+        row_end = tl.minimum(lim, split_end)
+
+        e_max = tl.zeros([BLOCK_H], dtype=tl.float32) - float("inf")
+        e_sum = tl.zeros([BLOCK_H], dtype=tl.float32)
+        acc = tl.zeros([BLOCK_H, BLOCK_DMODEL], dtype=tl.float32)
+        ks = tl.load(k_scale)
+        pt = Req_to_tokens + stride_req_to_tokens_b * cur_batch.to(tl.int64)
+        if QSPLIT:
+            # Software pipeline: the next K/V tile is loaded before this
+            # tile's math and the block table is read two tiles ahead, so
+            # global latency overlaps the MFMAs (one wave per SIMD here).
+            nkv_off = _verify_tile_off(
+                pt,
+                split_start,
+                split_end,
+                stride_buf_kpbs,
+                stride_buf_kbs,
+                BLOCK_N,
+                PAGE_SIZE,
+            )
+            nmask = split_start + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_N) < split_end
+            nk0, nk1, nv, nkpe = _verify_load_tile_qsplit(
+                K_Buffer, nkv_off, nmask, offs_d0, offs_d, offs_dpe, HALF, BLOCK_DPE
+            )
+            nkv_off = _verify_tile_off(
+                pt,
+                split_start + BLOCK_N,
+                split_end,
+                stride_buf_kpbs,
+                stride_buf_kbs,
+                BLOCK_N,
+                PAGE_SIZE,
+            )
+            for start_n in tl.range(split_start, split_end, BLOCK_N):
+                offs_n = start_n + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_N)
+                k0 = nk0
+                k1 = nk1
+                v = nv
+                kpe = nkpe
+                nmask = offs_n + BLOCK_N < split_end
+                if PAGE_SIZE < 8 and not K_Buffer.dtype.element_ty.is_fp8():
+                    # Two-tile block-table read-ahead spills VGPRs here.
+                    nkv_off = _verify_tile_off(
+                        pt,
+                        start_n + BLOCK_N,
+                        split_end,
+                        stride_buf_kpbs,
+                        stride_buf_kbs,
+                        BLOCK_N,
+                        PAGE_SIZE,
+                    )
+                nk0, nk1, nv, nkpe = _verify_load_tile_qsplit(
+                    K_Buffer,
+                    nkv_off,
+                    nmask,
+                    offs_d0,
+                    offs_d,
+                    offs_dpe,
+                    HALF,
+                    BLOCK_DPE,
+                )
+                nkv_off = _verify_tile_off(
+                    pt,
+                    start_n + 2 * BLOCK_N,
+                    split_end,
+                    stride_buf_kpbs,
+                    stride_buf_kbs,
+                    BLOCK_N,
+                    PAGE_SIZE,
+                )
+                if v.dtype.is_fp8():
+                    k0 = k0.to(tl.float32) * ks
+                    k1 = k1.to(tl.float32) * ks
+                    v = v.to(tl.float32) * ks
+                    kpe = kpe.to(tl.float32) * ks
+                qk = tl.dot(q, k0.to(q.dtype))
+                qk = tl.dot(q1, k1.to(q.dtype), qk)
+                if BLOCK_DPE > 0:
+                    qk = tl.dot(qpe, kpe.to(qpe.dtype), qk)
+                qk *= sm_scale_log2
+                qk = tl.where(offs_n[None, :] < row_end[:, None], qk, float("-inf"))
+
+                n_e_max = tl.maximum(tl.max(qk, 1), e_max)
+                safe_max = tl.where(n_e_max == float("-inf"), 0.0, n_e_max)
+                re_scale = tl.exp2(e_max - safe_max)
+                p = tl.exp2(qk - safe_max[:, None])
+                acc = acc * re_scale[:, None] + tl.dot(p.to(q.dtype), v.to(q.dtype))
+                e_sum = e_sum * re_scale + tl.sum(p, 1)
+                e_max = n_e_max
+        else:
+            for start_n in tl.range(split_start, split_end, BLOCK_N):
+                offs_n = start_n + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_N)
+                mask_n = offs_n < split_end
+                kv_off = _verify_tile_off(
+                    pt,
+                    start_n,
+                    split_end,
+                    stride_buf_kpbs,
+                    stride_buf_kbs,
+                    BLOCK_N,
+                    PAGE_SIZE,
+                )
+                k = tl.load(
+                    K_Buffer + kv_off[None, :] + offs_d[:, None],
+                    mask=mask_n[None, :],
+                    other=0.0,
+                )
+                if k.dtype.is_fp8():
+                    k = (k.to(tl.float32) * ks).to(q.dtype)
+                k = k.to(q.dtype)
+                qk = tl.dot(q, k)
+                # MLA reads V from the latent K tile.
+                v = tl.trans(k)
+                if BLOCK_DPE > 0:
+                    kpe = tl.load(
+                        K_Buffer + kv_off[None, :] + offs_dpe[:, None],
+                        mask=mask_n[None, :],
+                        other=0.0,
+                    )
+                    if kpe.dtype.is_fp8():
+                        kpe = (kpe.to(tl.float32) * ks).to(qpe.dtype)
+                    qk += tl.dot(qpe, kpe.to(qpe.dtype))
+                qk *= sm_scale_log2
+                qk = tl.where(offs_n[None, :] < row_end[:, None], qk, float("-inf"))
+
+                n_e_max = tl.maximum(tl.max(qk, 1), e_max)
+                safe_max = tl.where(n_e_max == float("-inf"), 0.0, n_e_max)
+                re_scale = tl.exp2(e_max - safe_max)
+                p = tl.exp2(qk - safe_max[:, None])
+                acc = acc * re_scale[:, None] + tl.dot(p.to(q.dtype), v)
+                e_sum = e_sum * re_scale + tl.sum(p, 1)
+                e_max = n_e_max
+
+        has = e_sum > 0.0
+        denom = tl.where(has, e_sum, 1.0)
+        if SINGLE:
+            tl.store(
+                Out
+                + q_row[:, None] * stride_obs
+                + head[:, None] * stride_oh
+                + offs_d[None, :],
+                (acc / denom[:, None]).to(Out.dtype.element_ty),
+                mask=row_valid[:, None],
+            )
+            tl.store(
+                Lse + q_row * stride_lse_bs + head * stride_lse_h,
+                tl.where(has, (e_max + tl.log2(denom)) * _LN2, float("-inf")),
+                mask=row_valid,
+            )
+        else:
+            offs_mid = (
+                q_row * stride_mid_ob
+                + head * stride_mid_oh
+                + split_kv_id * stride_mid_os
+            )
+            tl.store(
+                Att_Out + offs_mid[:, None] + offs_d[None, :],
+                acc / denom[:, None],
+                mask=row_valid[:, None],
+            )
+            # The LSE is computed after the tile store: the reverse order
+            # measured ~6% slower on gfx942 (16,8,32,16384).
+            tl.store(
+                Att_Out + offs_mid + Lv,
+                tl.where(has, e_max + tl.log2(denom), float("-inf")),
+                mask=row_valid,
+            )
+
+
+@triton.jit(do_not_specialize=["stride_mid_ob", "stride_mid_oh", "NUM_KV_SPLITS"])
+def _fwd_verify_kernel_stage2(
+    Mid_O,
+    o,
+    lse,
+    B_Seqlen,
+    Real_Seqlen,
+    stride_mid_ob,
+    stride_mid_oh,
+    stride_mid_os,
+    stride_obs,
+    stride_oh,
+    stride_lse_bs,
+    stride_lse_h,
+    QLEN: tl.constexpr,
+    HAS_REAL: tl.constexpr,
+    NUM_KV_SPLITS,
+    SPLIT_ALIGN: tl.constexpr,
+    MIN_SPLIT_LEN: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_S: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_DV: tl.constexpr,
+    Lv: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    # One (row, head) per program; BLOCK_S splits are combined per step so
+    # the loads of a step are independent (long split lists stay cheap).
+    q_row = tl.program_id(0)
+    head = tl.program_id(1)
+    cur_batch = q_row // QLEN
+    tok = q_row % QLEN
+
+    seq_len = tl.load(B_Seqlen + cur_batch)
+    L_cap = seq_len
+    if HAS_REAL:
+        L_cap = tl.minimum(seq_len, tl.load(Real_Seqlen + cur_batch))
+    L_cap = tl.maximum(L_cap, 0)
+    lim = tl.maximum(tl.minimum(seq_len - QLEN + 1 + tok, L_cap), 0)
+    per_split = _verify_split_len(L_cap, NUM_KV_SPLITS, SPLIT_ALIGN, MIN_SPLIT_LEN)
+    num_active = tl.cdiv(lim, per_split)
+
+    offs_d = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_DV)
+    offs_s = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_S)
+    base = q_row.to(tl.int64) * stride_mid_ob + head * stride_mid_oh
+
+    e_max = -float("inf")
+    e_sum = 0.0
+    acc = tl.zeros([BLOCK_DV], dtype=tl.float32)
+    for s0 in range(0, num_active, BLOCK_S):
+        sid = s0 + offs_s
+        mask_s = sid < num_active
+        off = base + sid * stride_mid_os
+        tlogic = tl.load(Mid_O + off + Lv, mask=mask_s, other=float("-inf"))
+        tv = tl.load(
+            Mid_O + off[:, None] + offs_d[None, :], mask=mask_s[:, None], other=0.0
+        )
+        n_e_max = tl.maximum(tl.max(tlogic, 0), e_max)
+        old_scale = tl.exp2(e_max - n_e_max)
+        w = tl.exp2(tlogic - n_e_max)
+        acc = acc * old_scale + tl.sum(w[:, None] * tv, 0)
+        e_sum = e_sum * old_scale + tl.sum(w, 0)
+        e_max = n_e_max
+
+    has = e_sum > 0.0
+    denom = tl.where(has, e_sum, 1.0)
+    tl.store(
+        o + q_row.to(tl.int64) * stride_obs + head * stride_oh + offs_d,
+        (acc / denom).to(o.dtype.element_ty),
+    )
+    tl.store(
+        lse + q_row.to(tl.int64) * stride_lse_bs + head * stride_lse_h,
+        tl.where(has, (e_max + tl.log2(denom)) * _LN2, float("-inf")),
+    )
+

+VERIFY_DEFAULT_CONFIG: dict[str, Any] = dict(
+    BLOCK_H=32,
+    BLOCK_N=16,
+    num_warps=4,
+    num_stages=1,
+    waves_per_eu=1,
+    matrix_instr_nonkdim=16,
+    kpack=2,
+    SPLIT_ALIGN=16,
+    MIN_SPLIT_LEN=256,
+    QSPLIT=False,
+    S2_BLOCK_S=16,
+    s2_num_warps=4,

+def verify_row_blocks(qlen: int, num_heads: int, block_h: int) -> int:
+    return triton.cdiv(qlen * num_heads, block_h)
+
+
+def verify_num_kv_splits(
+    max_seq_len: int,
+    batch: int,
+    qlen: int,
+    num_heads: int,
+    sm_count: int,
+    block_h: int = VERIFY_DEFAULT_CONFIG["BLOCK_H"],
+    occupancy: float = 1.0,
+    min_work_per_split: int = 64,
+    max_splits: int = 8,
+) -> int:
+    """Static upper bound on KV splits (safe to bake into a cudagraph).
+
+    The kernel splits each request's own length into
+    max(cdiv(L, splits), MIN_SPLIT_LEN) chunks, so this only caps the split
+    count. ``occupancy`` is the number of resident stage-1 programs per CU.
+    If one split of every request fits in a single dispatch round, use as many
+    splits as fit in that round; otherwise pick n <= max_splits minimising
+    rounds(n) / n (the idle tail of the last round), preferring fewer splits
+    within 5% of the best.
+    """
+    programs_per_split = max(1, batch) * verify_row_blocks(qlen, num_heads, block_h)
+    ideal = triton.cdiv(max(1, max_seq_len), max(1, min_work_per_split))
+    slots = max(1, int(occupancy * sm_count))
+    if programs_per_split <= slots:
+        n = slots // programs_per_split
+    else:
+        cost = [
+            (triton.cdiv(n * programs_per_split, slots) / n, n)
+            for n in range(1, max(1, min(ideal, max_splits)) + 1)
+        ]
+        best = min(c for c, _ in cost)
+        n = min(n for c, n in cost if c <= best * 1.05)
+    return max(1, min(ideal, n, sm_count * 2))
+

+def decode_attention_fwd_verify(
+    q,
+    k_buffer,
+    v_buffer,
+    o,
+    lse,
+    req_to_token,
+    seq_lens,
+    real_seq_lens,
+    qlen,
+    attn_logits,
+    num_kv_splits,
+    sm_scale,
+    page_size,
+    k_scale=None,
+):
+    """Causal MLA verify over a per-request block table.
+
+    Args:
+        q: [B * qlen, H, Lk] queries, verify tokens of a request contiguous.
+        k_buffer: paged latent cache, [num_pages, page_size, 1, Lk] (or 3D
+            [num_pages * page_size, 1, Lk]).
+        v_buffer: k_buffer[..., :Lv] (V is read from K; only its width is used).
+        o: [B * qlen, H, Lv] output.
+        lse: [B * qlen, H] fp32 natural-log LSE (-inf for rows with no key).
+        req_to_token: [B, max_pages] per-request block table (not repeated).
+        seq_lens: [B] int32 kernel KV lengths L.
+        real_seq_lens: [B] int32 or None; row limit is
+            max(min(L - qlen + 1 + t, L_real), 0).
+        qlen: verify tokens per request.
+        attn_logits: fp32 workspace with >= B * qlen * H * num_kv_splits *
+            (Lv + 1) elements, laid out [B * qlen, H, num_kv_splits, Lv + 1].
+            Unused, and may be None, when num_kv_splits is 1.
+        num_kv_splits: static cap on KV splits per request (see
+            verify_num_kv_splits); shorter requests use fewer, longer splits.
+        sm_scale: softmax scale.
+        page_size: tokens per KV cache page.
+        k_scale: scalar tensor dequantizing an FP8 cache; ignored for bf16.
+
+    """
+    cfg = select_verify_config(q.shape[0] // qlen, qlen, q.shape[1])
+    Lk = k_buffer.shape[-1]
+    Lv = v_buffer.shape[-1]
+    assert k_buffer.shape[-2] == 1, "verify path expects a single latent KV head"
+    num_rows, num_heads = q.shape[0], q.shape[1]
+    assert num_rows % qlen == 0
+    batch = num_rows // qlen
+    if num_kv_splits == 1:
+        # Stage 1 writes o / lse directly; o only stands in for the pointer.
+        attn_logits, mid_strides = o, (0, 0, 0)
+    else:
+        assert attn_logits.shape[-2] == num_kv_splits
+        mid_strides = attn_logits.stride()[:3]
+    if k_scale is None:
+        k_scale = torch.ones((), dtype=torch.float32, device=q.device)
+    BLOCK_DMODEL = triton.next_power_of_2(Lv)
+    BLOCK_DPE = triton.next_power_of_2(Lk - Lv) if Lk > Lv else 0
+    assert Lv == BLOCK_DMODEL and Lk == BLOCK_DMODEL + BLOCK_DPE
+    has_real = real_seq_lens is not None
+    real = real_seq_lens if has_real else seq_lens
+
+    hip_kw = {}
+    if is_hip_:
+        hip_kw = dict(
+            waves_per_eu=cfg["waves_per_eu"],
+            matrix_instr_nonkdim=cfg["matrix_instr_nonkdim"],
+            kpack=cfg["kpack"],
+        )
+    grid = (verify_row_blocks(qlen, num_heads, cfg["BLOCK_H"]) * batch * num_kv_splits,)
+    _fwd_verify_kernel_stage1[grid](
+        q,
+        k_buffer,
+        sm_scale * _LOG2E,
+        req_to_token,
+        seq_lens,
+        real,
+        attn_logits,
+        o,
+        lse,
+        req_to_token.stride(0),
+        q.stride(0),
+        q.stride(1),
+        _page_stride(k_buffer, page_size),
+        k_buffer.stride(-3),
+        *mid_strides,
+        o.stride(0),
+        o.stride(1),
+        lse.stride(0),
+        lse.stride(1),
+        k_scale,
+        batch,
+        QLEN=qlen,
+        NUM_HEADS=num_heads,
+        HAS_REAL=has_real,
+        BLOCK_DMODEL=BLOCK_DMODEL,
+        BLOCK_DPE=BLOCK_DPE,
+        BLOCK_N=cfg["BLOCK_N"],
+        BLOCK_H=cfg["BLOCK_H"],
+        NUM_KV_SPLITS=num_kv_splits,
+        SPLIT_ALIGN=cfg["SPLIT_ALIGN"],
+        MIN_SPLIT_LEN=cfg["MIN_SPLIT_LEN"],
+        PAGE_SIZE=page_size,
+        Lv=Lv,
+        QSPLIT=bool(cfg["QSPLIT"]),
+        SINGLE=num_kv_splits == 1,
+        num_warps=cfg["num_warps"],
+        num_stages=cfg["num_stages"],
+        **hip_kw,
+    )
+    if num_kv_splits == 1:
+        return  # stage 1 wrote o / lse
+    _fwd_verify_kernel_stage2[(num_rows, num_heads)](
+        attn_logits,
+        o,
+        lse,
+        seq_lens,
+        real,
+        attn_logits.stride(0),
+        attn_logits.stride(1),
+        attn_logits.stride(2),
+        o.stride(0),
+        o.stride(1),
+        lse.stride(0),
+        lse.stride(1),
+        QLEN=qlen,
+        HAS_REAL=has_real,
+        NUM_KV_SPLITS=num_kv_splits,
+        SPLIT_ALIGN=cfg["SPLIT_ALIGN"],
+        MIN_SPLIT_LEN=cfg["MIN_SPLIT_LEN"],
+        BLOCK_S=cfg["S2_BLOCK_S"],
+        BLOCK_DV=triton.next_power_of_2(Lv),
+        Lv=Lv,
+        num_warps=cfg["s2_num_warps"],
+        num_stages=1,
+    )
+
+
+_VERIFY_SMALL_CONFIG: dict[str, Any] = dict(
+    BLOCK_H=32, BLOCK_N=32, num_warps=4, kpack=1, MIN_SPLIT_LEN=128, occupancy=2.0
+)
+# 64-row tiles, Q and the QK operand split in two 256-wide halves (QSPLIT,
+# which also enables the K/V prefetch), 32 keys per step on 4 warps. 8 warps
+# cap VGPRs at 256 and spill or idle MFMA rows here.
+_VERIFY_LARGE_CONFIG: dict[str, Any] = dict(
+    BLOCK_H=64,
+    BLOCK_N=32,
+    num_warps=4,
+    QSPLIT=True,
+    MIN_SPLIT_LEN=128,
+    occupancy=1.0,
+)

+_VERIFY_SMALL_MAX_ROWS = 640

+def select_verify_config(batch: int, qlen: int, num_heads: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Launch config from MI300X (gfx942) sweeps, bf16, page 16.
+
+    Few rows (B * qlen * H <= 640): 32-row tiles with more KV splits fill the
+    GPU. Otherwise 64-row tiles (Q split in two 256-wide halves, next K/V
+    tile prefetched) halve the KV re-reads per request.
+    """
+    cfg = dict(VERIFY_DEFAULT_CONFIG)
+    if batch * qlen * num_heads <= _VERIFY_SMALL_MAX_ROWS:
+        cfg.update(_VERIFY_SMALL_CONFIG)
+    else:
+        cfg.update(_VERIFY_LARGE_CONFIG)
+    return cfg

+def _storage_view(t, shape):
+    """Contiguous ``shape`` over ``t``'s storage, or a new tensor if too small."""
+    if math.prod(shape) > t.untyped_storage().nbytes() // t.element_size():
+        return t.new_empty(shape)
+    strides = [1]
+    for size in reversed(shape[1:]):
+        strides.insert(0, strides[0] * size)
+    return torch.as_strided(t, shape, strides, 0)
+
+
+def warmup_decode_attention_fwd_verify(
+    q,
+    k_buffer,
+    o,
+    lse,
+    req_to_token,
+    has_real,
+    qlens,
+    attn_logits,
+    sm_scale,
+    page_size,
+    k_scale=None,
+):
+    """Compile every launch variant serving can reach for these tensors.
+
+    A launch specializes on qlen, the row-count config and a single split, but
+    graph capture and profiling only run the full verify length. Each variant
+    runs once on scratch tensors with the strides of the real ones; the split
+    scratch reuses attn_logits' storage, whose size the launch specializes on.
+    """
+    num_heads, Lv = q.shape[1], o.shape[-1]
+    if attn_logits is None:
+        attn_logits = q.new_empty(0, dtype=torch.float32)
+
+    def scratch(t, rows):
+        return torch.empty_strided(
+            (rows, *t.shape[1:]), t.stride(), dtype=t.dtype, device=t.device
+        )
+
+    for qlen in qlens:
+        for batch in {1, _VERIFY_SMALL_MAX_ROWS // (qlen * num_heads) + 1}:
+            rows = batch * qlen
+            seq_lens = torch.full((batch,), qlen, dtype=torch.int32, device=q.device)
+            block_table = torch.empty_strided(
+                (batch, req_to_token.shape[1]),
+                req_to_token.stride(),
+                dtype=req_to_token.dtype,
+                device=req_to_token.device,
+            ).zero_()
+            for num_kv_splits in (1, 2):
+                decode_attention_fwd_verify(
+                    scratch(q, rows).zero_(),
+                    k_buffer,
+                    k_buffer[..., :Lv],
+                    scratch(o, rows),
+                    scratch(lse, rows),
+                    block_table,
+                    seq_lens,
+                    seq_lens if has_real else None,
+                    qlen,
+                    None
+                    if num_kv_splits == 1
+                    else _storage_view(
+                        attn_logits, (rows, num_heads, num_kv_splits, Lv + 1)
+                    ),

Where the tolerance comes from: the kernel rounds to bf16 twice, so the bound has two terms.

- P (the softmax weights, in [0, 1]) is rounded to bf16 before the PV dot. That is at most 2^-9 relative per weight, and the weights sum to 1, so the error is at most 2^-9 · max|V|. I budget 2^-8 · max|V| as `atol` to leave room for exp2 and accumulation-order differences against the fp32 reference.
- The output is rounded to bf16 once more, which is at most 2^-9 relative, so `rtol` is 2^-8.
- FP8 compares against the dequantized cache, so the same bound applies with V already scaled (k_scale 3).

The new bound is not too tight either: with `rtol=0`, the worst error is 0.89 · 2^-8 · max|V|, so halving `atol` would start failing. Every bug I injected fails by a wide margin: dropping the V scale (170x the bound), a causal off-by-one (394x), the wrong exp base (30x), and P rounded to FP8 (4.8x). 30/30 seeded runs of the test pass.

+    lse,
+    B_Seqlen,
+    Real_Seqlen,

+    stride_mid_oh,
+    stride_mid_os,
+    stride_obs,
+    stride_oh,
+    stride_lse_bs,
+    stride_lse_h,
+    QLEN: tl.constexpr,
+    HAS_REAL: tl.constexpr,
+    NUM_KV_SPLITS,
+    SPLIT_ALIGN: tl.constexpr,
+    MIN_SPLIT_LEN: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_S: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_DV: tl.constexpr,

+    offs_s = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_S)

I hadn't benchmarked the per-token row-view route (what gfx942 DCP verify uses) before writing this kernel, so I've run it now on MI300X: as it ships, and with its launch config and split count tuned for gfx942. Per layer, both kernels in HIP graphs on identical inputs with a production-size KV pool, row-view as it ships is 1.8-4.6x slower. Tuned, it is still 1.44x slower on geomean (0.96-2.4x across 16-128 heads and batch 1-64). End to end, DeepSeek-V2-Lite, ngram k=7, TP1, one server at a time on the same GPU, output tok/s:

| | InstructCoder c1 / c32 | random 1k/256 c1 / c32 |
|---|---|---|
| this PR | 426 / 3864 | 490 / 4606 |
| row-view, tuned | 400 / 3520 | 454 / 4086 |
| row-view, as it ships | 290 / 3385 | 313 / 3511 |

So the kernel buys 6-8% at c1 over a tuned row-view, and stays ahead at c32 in every round I ran (about 10-13%, though c32 is noisy on this host). Over the row-view we have today it is 14-56%. GSM8K is 0.648-0.668 on every arm, and TP2 shows the same ordering. The comparison also turned up a slowdown in this kernel with `--block-size 1` once the KV cache passes 2 GiB: Triton builds a variant there that spills registers. I've pushed a small fix (2-3x on that kernel, no change at the default block size) and added the fair comparison to the description.
